tuto.shell.bienvenue.texte: Table Sync tracks your character during the game: HP, spells, inventory… everything updates live, for you and your GM. A quick tour?
tuto.shell.bandeau.texte: This band shows your HP, AC and spell slots on every tab. Tap it to heal or take damage in one gesture.
tuto.shell.onglets.texte: Survival first, then the most useful ones for your class. One tap, one tab — everything else hides behind the centre button.
tuto.shell.hub.texte: Inventory, Features, Description, NPCs, Notes… they all live here. And in combat it becomes your indicator: it turns red and calls on you when it's your turn.
tuto.shell.fin.texte: Replay this tour anytime: “My account → Reset tutorial”. Next stop: Survival, the heart of play.
tuto.survival.vitalite.texte: Your hit points and temp HP. The ±1 / ±5 buttons are quick; at 0 HP, death saves appear on their own.
tuto.survival.attaques.texte: Your weapons with the right numbers: the 🎯 chip shows the attack bonus, ⚔ damage, ✨ magic. Ability, proficiency, fighting style… it's all computed by the rules.
tuto.survival.des-vie.texte: Your hit-dice pool, one counter per class. A long rest returns half of them; during a short rest, spend them to heal.
tuto.survival.etats.texte: Conditions and exhaustion, with durations. They follow your character everywhere: your sheet and the GM's tracker stay in sync.
tuto.survival.ressources.texte: Rage, ki, sorcery points… your features' counters, with their maximum computed at your current level.
tuto.survival.repos.texte: One tap applies the rules: slots, resources, hit dice. And your GM watches you rest live.
tuto.survival.forme.texte: Pick a beast you've seen: the sheet tracks its HP, the auto-revert at 0, and the CR gates for your level.
tuto.stats.scores.texte: STR, DEX… editable right here; every modifier and save follows instantly.
tuto.stats.derivees.texte: Everything that's computed: initiative, passive perception, speed… recomputed live from your classes, gear and conditions.
tuto.stats.ca.texte: Your armour and shield set the Armor Class. Unexpected magic item? Switch to “Manual” and type it — “↺ Auto” returns to the rules.
tuto.stats.portage.texte: What you can carry, computed from your STR and your bag's real weight — coins included. An ×N multiplier covers mules and hirelings.
tuto.stats.vitesse.texte: It slows with encumbrance and mishandled heavy armour, and adapts to your wild shape — Monk and Barbarian earn their bonuses here.
tuto.skills.sauvegardes.texte: Your six saves, with proficiency where it applies — and the paladin's aura adds itself from level 6.
tuto.skills.competences.texte: One tap goes from nothing to proficiency ●; a second one, to expertise ◉ (double bonus). Expertise slots are counted per your class.
tuto.skills.outils-langues.texte: 39 SRD tools and 16 languages, plus your own entries. Expertise applies to thieves' tools too.
tuto.skills.maitrises.texte: Your class's list by default. Exotic blade won in play? Add it — otherwise the sheet flags ⚠ unproficient attacks.
tuto.spells.emplacements.texte: One counter per level. Pact magic recharges on a short rest, the rest on a long one — the sheet knows which to spend.
tuto.spells.lancer.texte: The ✨ button opens casting: pick the level, the sheet shows damage or healing scaled, then spends the slot.
tuto.spells.concentration.texte: One concentration spell at a time. Take damage and the sheet prompts the save — break it if you drop.
tuto.spells.toujours-prepares.texte: Domain, circle or oath spells carry a ◆: always ready, and they don't count against your prepared limit.
tuto.spells.grimoire.texte: The ★ star prepares a spell, within your class's limit; swipe the row left to forget it.
tuto.spells.cantrips.texte: Level 0, so always “at will”: they consume no slot, rest or not.
tuto.inventory.rangements.texte: The default backpack, plus your containers and mounts — each with its own weight and load bar. Tap a pill to open it.
tuto.inventory.sac.texte: Your gear at a glance. Drag to reorder, drop an item onto another storage to move it.
tuto.inventory.puces.texte: 🎯 attack, ⚔ damage, ✨ magic, ×N extra attacks… and ⚠ if the weapon isn't proficient. Computed, never copied.
tuto.inventory.transfert.texte: “↗ Transfer” sends an item — or coins — to another character in the party: they see it appear without reloading.
tuto.inventory.bourse.texte: GP, SP, CP and the total. Everything has weight: even coins count toward your carry limit.
tuto.inventory.catalogue.texte: The ✚ button (or the right-hand column) opens the catalog: search “rope” or “sword”, add with one tap. Can't find it? “Create an item” shows the way.
tuto.inventory.poids.texte: Each storage shows its total in kg — weapons, coins and containers included. Over your limit, your speed pays for it.
tuto.features.catalogue.texte: The 307 official SRD features, by class and level — Action Surge, Indomitable, Channel Divinity… Officialdom, one tap away.
tuto.features.ajout.texte: Each feature arrives with its description and, if it has a counter, its pool: rage 2/2, ki points… set to your level.
tuto.features.compteurs.texte: Each counter ticks what it recovers — pre-checked per the SRD. Untick to manage it by hand.
tuto.features.ma-liste.texte: Your list stays editable: rename, reorder, add whatever the GM grants off-catalog.
tuto.description.identite.texte: The “Class A n / Class B n” summary, editable lines: level, subclass, fighting style. SRD multiclassing handled.
tuto.description.ajouter-classe.texte: Guided form: ⚠ prerequisites and gained proficiencies shown before you confirm. The sheet recomputes HP, slots and attacks.
tuto.description.histoire.texte: Appearance, personality, backstory, allies… and visibility: what the GM and other players can see of your sheet.
tuto.npcs.figures.texte: Allies, contacts, recurring rivals: each NPC keeps its appearance and notes, ready to return.
tuto.npcs.ajouter.texte: A simple card, ready in thirty seconds — so the odious merchant comes back to haunt you.
tuto.notes.libres.texte: Clues, debts, promises… Title, content, order, and the 👁 preview to reread at the table.
tuto.notes.partout.texte: Saved as you type, synced with your account: tablet tonight, phone next week — nothing to copy over.
tuto.messages.fil.texte: Trade privately with the GM: clues, secrets, revelations the table must not hear. This thread belongs to this character — the history stays here.
tuto.messages.partout.texte: An incoming message drops a banner wherever you are, a badge counts the unread — and if the app is closed, a notification fires.
account.tutoriel.aide: The guided tour walks you through the sheet: status band, tabs, survival, spells, inventory…
account.tutoriel.toast: Guided tour re-enabled — it starts next time you open a sheet.
account.notifications.aide: Get alerted outside the app — screen off or app in the background.
account.notifications.aide.actives: This browser will receive notifications, even when closed.
account.notifications.test.repare: Subscription repaired — notification sent, check your screen.
account.notifications.contexte.non.secur: Notifications require HTTPS: this page is served over plain HTTP. Open the app via its https:// address.
account.notifications.non.supporte: This browser doesn't support web notifications. On iPhone/iPad: add Table Sync to your home screen (iOS 16.4 or later) and reopen it from its icon.
account.notifications.desactivees.serveu: Notifications are disabled on this server — the DM must configure the VAPID keys there (docs/push-notifications.md).
account.notifications.permission.refusee: Permission denied — re-enable notifications in the browser settings (the 🔒 icon next to the address, or Settings → Table Sync on iOS).
account.notifications.appareil.note: Subscriptions are per device: each tablet and browser opts in on its own.
